about: Before/after report on the golden sets (flow stage). Before: docs/accuracy/before/ (the code before any fix). After: this commit, priced by scripts/accuracy/report.ts. Every difference a customer or the office would see is listed with the ledger entries (docs/accuracy/ledger.txt) and the owner decision behind it; "stage" is the stage that made it. The live set keeps estimate ids, statuses and amounts only.
